stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump mail ballot restrictions, administration pledges compliance
new_facts: Supreme Court blocked Trump's Postal Service mail-ballot rules; Trump denounces his three appointees who joined ruling.
AG Todd Blanche publicly defended Trump's angry comments about the justices.
Bipartisan election officials are redoubling efforts to assure Americans mail ballots are safe after the ruling.
Trump administration says it will comply with the Supreme Court's mail ballot ruling, per Blanche.
Trump claims the ruling 'sets the US back 100 years.'
ACLU argues before SC Supreme Court that Gov. McMaster lacked authority to deploy National Guard to DC.
Report notes SCOTUS also previously rejected Trump initiatives on tariffs and citizenship, beyond the Guard and election rulings.
Trump quote: his appointees 'are not the people I interviewed.'
stories.line: Supreme Court blocked Trump administration rules that would have restricted mail ballot processing; administration says it will comply.

stories.title: Trump-aligned board closes Kennedy Center after judge blocks renaming

Names Judge Christopher Cooper and details exact ruling blocking 'Donald J. Trump' naming language on building/plaza.
Adds figure: $257 million renovation plan Trump says depends on recognizing his role.
Names Rep. Joyce Beatty as the Democratic board member Trump berated on the call.
Reports board was scheduled to vote on closing the center for two years.
stories.line: Trump-aligned Kennedy Center board votes to close the venue for renovations after a judge blocks renaming it after Trump.

stories.title: GOP Rep. Massie introduces impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Hegseth
new_facts: Introduces new story: Rep. Thomas Massie calls to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over Iran war/interventionism.
Massie formally introduces impeachment articles, accusing Hegseth of defying Congress and suppressing free speech.
Massie filed eight articles of impeachment calling war 'unlawful at its inception' and citing lack of congressional authorization.
Resolution filed as privileged, forcing a House floor vote within two days ahead of midterms.
stories.line: A Republican congressman introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war concerns.

stories.title: Incomes rise, poverty falls in 2025 as safety net cuts loom
new_facts: Census Bureau reports 2025 median household income of $87,460 (record) and poverty rate falling to 10.2%.
Adds that typical household earnings rose just 2.5% since 2019 despite record income level.
Notes poverty rate was stable before Trump's safety net cuts intensified, implying future risk to gains.
Reports health insurance coverage was little changed from 2024 and warns safety net cuts could erase 2025 gains.
stories.line: Census data shows incomes rose and poverty fell in 2025, but incoming policy changes threaten to reverse the gains.
